Title: Generally available: Azure Site Recovery update rollup 67 - May 2023

Body.Content:
This update provides the following improvements for the latest version of Azure Site Recovery components. 

 

Mobility Service – Added support for Linux OS for:

  •  
  • Azure to Azure - Oracle Linux 8.7 with UEK7 kernel, RHEL 9, and Cent OS 9
  • Modernized VMware/Physical to Azure - Oracle Linux 8.7 with UEK7 kernel, RHEL 9, and Cent OS 9

 

This update also provides bug fixes. 

Learn more about the issues fixed and get the download links.
